1. 粘贴 Excel 多列内容或导入 CSV / TSV，指定文件名列。支持完:
1. Paste Excel cells or import CSV / TSV, then choose the filename column. Match complete names, names without extensions, or ID prefixes. Matching ignores case. ID candidates always need confirmation.

2. Add source folders and scan. Select a checklist row to review candidates and choose a file. Repeated requests remain separate rows.

3. Choose a destination separate from the sources. Click Copy to destination, review the actual paths, then copy. Existing files are never overwritten. Every checklist row appears in the report.

4. Save a .fctask task. When missing files arrive, reopen it and scan again. Completed rows remain complete only after source and copy contents are verified. Changed files need confirmation.

Recovery snapshots are saved after each operation under %LOCALAPPDATA%\FileChecklist\Recovery. Use File > Recover last task. A manually saved task is a snapshot from that moment.

Ordinary local folders are supported. Links, directory junctions and cloud placeholders are skipped. A filename and checksum cannot establish the correct business version. Import CSV columns as text in Excel to retain leading zeros.

No account or upload is required. Tasks and reports contain local paths. Review them before sharing.

Language follows your Windows display language: Chinese for Chinese locales, English otherwise. You can start FileChecklist.exe --lang en or FileChecklist.exe --lang zh to override it.
